notes.title: “Soaring Machinariae” Release!
notes.notes:
Dear all

We are pleased to announce that we have started distributing the Steam version of " Soaring Machinariae”, a girl's adventure action RPG.

https://youtu.be/-IXl6NesxFo

Please enjoy the story in full voice, all 31 music tracks by game music creator Kensei, and the adventures of Iris, a special Automaton known as a Machinariae!

You can purchase the soundtrack from 11th June 2021 to 30th June 2021 at a 30% off price. It is optimized for listening to music and as a game material, so please enjoy it as well.

Soaring Machinariae Music Resources & Sound Tracks
https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ290961.html


[About the included resources]
ogg / m4a :
These datas are optimized for use as music resources.
Since LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH tags have already been embedded, loop playback is automatically possible on production software that supports loop tags, such as "RPG Maker MV/MZ".

mp3 :
These datas are optimized for listening. The order of the songs has been rearranged, and two loops plus a fade-out process have been added.
Tags such as album name and song title, as well as artwork images that can be displayed on various players, are already embedded.

There is no problem if you use the mp3 as a material.
